# Diffuse

> Local-first native apps that answer one question: what changed on this device between two points in time?

Diffuse is not a cloud product. Five genuinely native apps — Android, macOS, iOS, iPadOS, watchOS — capture and compare snapshots on the device that observed them. The four Apple apps share a Swift domain engine. Android is native Kotlin. Snapshots never leave the device. There is no account, no telemetry, and no third-party Swift packages.

- Site: https://hoangsonww.github.io/Diffuse-Native-Apps/
- Source: https://github.com/hoangsonww/Diffuse-Native-Apps
- License: MIT
